annotations.title: What your funds cost a year

description: Computes, on the funds and amounts the user gives, what each fund's expense ratio takes a year (amount × expense ratio), the total and the weighted ratio, with the expense ratios of Portfolio Terminal's fees view (the fund's latest annual report as Yahoo Finance lists it). A fact, not a verdict: no other fund is suggested. A line that is not a fund, or whose ratio is not published, is named. Nothing is stored. Use it for "how much do my ETFs cost me a year".

funds.description: One line per fund: its ticker and what is invested in it now. At most 50.

amount.description: What the holding is worth now, in `currency`.

name: fund_fees
title: What your funds cost a year
